source_review_notes: DBAASP linked assay and experiment snapshots duplicate the same 22 source rows; both snapshot surfaces were audited.

No linked sequence rows are present; source verification is based on primary compound name/structure/citation evidence and modified-lipolanthine identity, not plain sequence normalization.
